mapper.select: SELECT cstmr_name ,cellphone ,cstmr_login_id FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_name=#{cstmrName} and cellphone = #{cellphone}
SELECT cstmr_id ,cstmr_name ,cellphone ,cstmr_login_id ,cstmr_login_pw ,email FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_name=#{cstmrName} and cellphone = #{cellphone} and cstmr_login_id = #{cstmrLoginId}

SELECT cstmr_id ,cstmr_cd ,cstmr_name ,telephone ,cellphone ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,zip_cd ,email ,addr ,bigo ,get_sms_yn ,get_email_yn ,facebook ,twitter ,instagram FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_login_id=#{cstmrLoginId} and cstmr_login_pw=#{cstmrLoginPw}

SELECT C.cstmr_name ,C.birth_day ,C.birth_day_ty_cd ,C.cellphone ,C.addr ,C.cstmr_cd ,C.email ,C.facebook ,C.twitter ,C.instagram ,V.gsph_left ,V.gsph_right ,V.datetime ,(select count(coupon_id) from coupon where cstmr_id=#{cstmrId})coupon ,(select count(cstmr_id) from sale where cstmr_id=#{cstmrId})buyCount FROM cstmr C LEFT JOIN visit_history V ON C.cstmr_id = V.cstmr_id WHERE C.cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} ORDER BY V.datetime DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT datetime ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = S.shop_id) shopName ,(select sum(prc) from salePrdct where sale_id = S.sale_id) ognPrice ,(select prdct_name from prdct, salePrdct P where prdct.prdct_id=P.prdct_id AND prdct.prdct_ty_cd='00300001' AND P.sale_id = S.sale_id) frame ,(select prdct_name from prdct, salePrdct P where prdct.prdct_id=P.prdct_id AND prdct.prdct_ty_cd='00300002' AND P.sale_id = S.sale_id) lens FROM sale S WHERE cstmr_id = #{cstmrId}
ORDER BY datetime DESC;
SELECT coupon_name, coupon_cd, start_date, end_date, dscnt_prcnt, dscnt_prc FROM coupon WHERE cstmr_id = #{cstmrId}
SELECT email FROM cstmr WHERE email is not null
